從下面的元件庫點或拖元件（「⋯」可以改放左邊）；「接線」模式照路線畫就會排成直角: Tap or drag components from the library below (“⋯” can move it to the left); in Wire mode, draw along the route to get right-angle wires. You can drag components with your finger. A selected component shows rotate, flip, duplicate and delete beside it; tap it again to name it, and R_1 or x^2 in a name become subscripts or superscripts. Tap a wire to select it, and tap again to name or delete it; wire names can be dragged and resized. Circle several with Pencil from empty space, then tap “Group”; tap “Custom Circuit” to save the selection to the library, and it comes out as one group later. “Draw Component” lets you draw your own symbol with Lines (ends snap to grid points) and Brush (pause to get a line or shape), then mark the pins; or tap “JSON” → “Copy Instructions for AI” and give them to an AI with a photo of your drawing, then paste the JSON it replies with. With “Place Components Continuously” in “⋯” turned off, you go back to Select after placing one. You can also swipe over things with the Eraser (double-tap Pencil to switch); they're deleted when the pen lifts. Circuits can be exported as SVG.
